title: Bitcoin (BTC) 📉 -1.4%

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What might Bitcoin’s current dip mean for its future as a global financial standard?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Lightning Network enables fast, low-cost transactions, but scalability still limits mass adoption.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Centralized finance’s dominance raises concerns about Bitcoin’s role in financial inclusion.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Developers are working on layer-2 solutions and improved consensus mechanisms to reduce friction.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If trust grows, Bitcoin could empower unbanked populations and reshape global wealth distribution.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The path forward will depend on balancing innovation with ethical responsibility.
